claims.head: The Bruins want Pastrňák away from the big guns
claims.call: The Bruins’ L1 (Peterka, Zacha and Pastrňák) spends at least 29% of its 5-on-5 time against the Predators’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Bruins keep sending Pastrňák’s line (Peterka, Zacha and Pastrňák) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Marco Sturm has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Predators’ fourth line is Pinchuk, Wood and Höglander.
claims.nums: At home: 29% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 19% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Marco Sturm likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Predators’ fourth line.

claims.head: The Predators get in close, the Bruins shoot from distance
claims.body: On shots from in close, Nashville is near the top of the league, but Boston is near the bottom. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Predators to do more of their damage around the net.

notes.text: Mavrik Bourque is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-six forward.
Jayden Struble joined from MTL on Oct 10 and has played beside Nicolas Hague.
Michael Eyssimont has not played this season. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Connor Clifton has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Will Borgen has taken his spot beside Nikita Zadorov.

BOS.head: Anybody’s game
BOS.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Boston has home-ice advantage. The Bruins can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

NSH.head: Nothing to separate these two
NSH.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Boston has home-ice advantage. The Predators can tip it if their penalty kill holds up.
